scripts.dev: brew services start postgresql@16 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'node.*server.js' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'vite' 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server && concurrently -n "client,server" -c "cyan,green" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.db:setup: export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@16/bin:$PATH" && psql postgres -c "CREATE USER portfolio_user WITH PASSWORD 'localdev123';" 2>/dev/null; psql postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE portfolio OWNER portfolio_user;" 2>/dev/null; psql portfolio -U portfolio_user -f database/schema.sql
